lede: Brazil runs through the day. Its general election and Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva take two of Wikipedia's top five slots, 817,428 views between them, and Lemmy's feed carries the headline that Lula has been declared the winner as Bolsonaro rejects the result. Away from the politics, Eric Bauza leads every single page on Wikipedia at 511,715 views, while Polymarket stays calm on the macro call, pricing a 94 percent chance of no change from the Fed at its October meeting.
